items.title: Knicks have no late-game magic as they’re eliminated from NBA Cup title defense
items.summary: Miami Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo pulls down a rebound away from New York Knicks guard Jalen Brunson on Friday, Nov. 27, 2026, in New York.Jalen Brunson is mortal. Captain Clutch had a chance to tie the game with three free throws after Ryan Conwell’s boneheaded foul on Brunson’s corner 3-pointer with 9.8 seconds left in the game. But Brunson’s first free throw clanked off the rim — a rare shortcoming for Brunson in a big moment. He made the next two, leaving the Knicks trailing by one. But they weren’t able to foul on the subsequent Heat possession, as Pelle Larsson’s dunk put the Heat back up three with 7.2 seconds left. Brunson missed a 3-pointer on the other end, and the Knicks’ six-game winning streak came to an end as they fell 108-105 on Friday night at Madison Square Garden. items.summary: Jazz center Jusuf Nurkic will make his 2026/27 regular season debut on Friday against Denver, the team announced today (via Twitter). The Bosnian big man was originally listed as questionable for Friday’s game vs. the Nuggets. Nurkic suffered a partial plantar plate tear of the second toe in his right foot during Utah’s preseason opener on October 4. He has been sidelined for the past seven-plus weeks due to the injury. items.summary: Defending champion Germany, which won the 2023 FIBA World Cup behind strong play from MVP Dennis Schröder, was among five teams that qualified for the 2027 FIBA World Cup on Friday. The German men’s national team, currently No. 2 (behind the United States) in FIBA’s world rankings, defeated Latvia by two points on Friday to improve to 8-1 in Group K of the European qualifiers. Olympic silver medalist France, No. 3 in FIBA’s rankings, also secured a spot in next year’s World Cup on Friday by improving to 8-1 in the qualifiers. France, which finished a disappointing 18th at the 2023 World Cup, defeated Estonia to qualify for the 32-team tournament. items.summary: The Grizzlies have been granted a hardship exception and have used it to sign center Lawson Lovering to a 10-day contract, reports Shams Charania of ESPN (Twitter link). The signing is official, the team confirmed in a press release (Twitter link). A hardship exception allows a team hit hard by injuries to temporarily exceed the standard 15-man limit. A club qualifies if it has at least four players who have missed three or more games, assuming each of those four players is expected to be out for at least two more weeks. Memphis forwards Jerami Grant (calf) and Cameron Boozer (ankle) have been sidelined for the past three games and aren’t expected to return anytime soon.
